faq.q: How much does the mini stand-on loader cost to rent?
faq.a: $249.99 per day, $1,049.93 per week, or $2,999.70 per month. Pricing is final after we confirm dates and delivery. Request a booking right from this site.

Free delivery within King Township. $99.99 flat delivery fee for the Greater Toronto Area — includes both drop-off AND pickup by King Equipment Rental. This is the cheapest delivery rate in the industry. For other locations in Southern Ontario, please request via the form and we'll quote delivery before we book.

faq.q: Do you deliver to Aurora, Newmarket, or Richmond Hill?
faq.a: Yes — these are all part of our GTA flat-rate delivery zone. We serve the full north GTA halo including Aurora, Newmarket, Richmond Hill, Vaughan, north Toronto, and Bradford.

faq.q: How many days can I rent for?
faq.a: Anywhere from a single day to multi-week or multi-month rentals. Rates are tiered: daily for short rentals, weekly when you cross 7 days, monthly when you cross 30 days.

faq.q: Does the rental come with an operator?
faq.a: By default, no — the renter operates. Stand-on platform with a lighter learning curve than a full-size loader. If you'd like a trained operator on the job, we offer that as an add-on at $299.99 per day — just tick the box on the booking form.
The mini stand-on loader comes with a standard bucket. If you need a specific attachment, mention it in your booking request.
Use the booking form on this site to pick your dates, delivery option, and contact details. We confirm dates and delivery via email within a few hours during business hours.
